heading: FAQ’s on Finance App Development Solutions

items.question: How secure is the app?
items.answer: We use encryption, secure authentication and fraud checks, and follow industry best practices.

items.question: Does it support KYC?
items.answer: Yes. Identity verification and KYC workflows can be integrated.

items.question: Can it integrate with banks and gateways?
items.answer: Yes. We integrate with banking APIs and payment gateways relevant to your market.

items.question: How long does it take to launch?
items.answer: A branded launch typically takes 6–8 weeks, depending on integrations and customisation.

items.question: Is the app compliant with regulations?
items.answer: We build to your regulatory requirements; compliance depends on your licences and market.

items.question: How much does a finance app cost?
items.answer: Cost depends on features and integrations. Share your requirements for an estimate.
